messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "Refund issued on TK-480515 (the other order) instead of the confirmed TK-480155.", "verifier": {"reason": "The assistant violated the policy by refunding the wrong order (TK-480515 instead of TK-480155), despite the user's explicit and confirmed request for a refund on TK-480155. This constitutes a clear deviation from the user's intent and the policy's requirement to act on confirmed requests."}}
